messages:
Maria: quick alert: release job is blocked in verify after a cache-prune ran during prefetch. deploybot kept hitting 412s from artifact-index.
Aj: saw the alert. deploybot UI shows repeated 'manifest not found' for a small subset of artifacts.
Sourav: pasting relevant lines from the index logs:
```
2026-03-22T03:10:02Z cache-prune: starting shard=17 range=[2026-03-01..2026-03-22]
2026-03-22T03:10:03Z index: delete key=/index/shard-17/manifest/sha256:abcd...
2026-03-22T03:10:03Z verify: read index for sha256:abcd... -> 412 manifest missing
2026-03-22T03:10:04Z deploybot: verify retry attempt=2 id=sha256:abcd...
2026-03-22T03:10:04Z deploybot: verify queue starved waiting on index lock
```
Tay: this is very similar to the prune vs prefetch race we saw in 2025 Q4. parallel prefetch + aggressive prune hits a window.
deploybot: promotion paused: holding at verify step. Default behavior: exponential backoff up to 10m. Pending verifies: 38.
Maria: change-window is 40m. We need a call: do we pin to last-known-good (sha256:1234) and force-promote, or attempt shard repair which could take longer?
Aj: last-known-good was validated in canary and smoke; it's missing today's tiny tweak but ok for release.
Sourav: two tradeoffs: pin now = unblock release fast. repair = fix root cause but risk missing the change window.
Tay: I'm +1 for pin given the change-window. We should also throttle prune and add a pre-prune quiesce.
ci-bot: quick regression check: last-known-good (sha256:1234) passed the full matrix earlier today, no failures.
Maria: ok let's manual promote to sha256:1234. I'll schedule the promote and include rationale in the release notes. 2 minute objection window.
Aj: +1 from release. Also add rollback hook note in case client reports issues.
Sourav: I'll open ARTIFACTS-902 (investigate prune race) and ARTIFACTS-903 (pre-prune quiesce) and link logs.
Maria: executing: /promote --image sha256:1234 --by maria --note "pin due to index prune verify failures"
deploybot: promote request accepted. Skipping prefetch. Verify queued on runner-3.
deploybot: verify succeeded on runner-3 id=sha256:1234. Promotion progressing to rollout.
deploybot: rollout complete. Release window maintained. :tada:
Maria: release notes draft: "Pinned to known-good image to avoid promotion stalls caused by artifact-index prune during prefetch; follow-ups: prune quiesce during deploys, shard-repair automation, post-release index integrity check."
Tay: suggest also adding an automated alert when verify queue > 20 after a prune job.
Aj: capturing action items: ARTIFACTS-902, ARTIFACTS-903, RELEASE-412 (post-release validation), INFRA-120 (prune alert).
Sourav: pinging artifact-index on-call and attaching logs+prune window.
Maria: thanks team. closing.
